achievements.name: Fighter Jet
achievements.detail: Fight off the angels swarming the fighter jet in the opening battle over the city.

achievements.name: Witch Time
achievements.detail: Dodge an attack at the last instant and strike back while Witch Time holds.

achievements.name: Wicked Weave
achievements.detail: Finish a punch-and-kick string so a giant demonic limb crashes into the verse.

achievements.name: Torture Attack
achievements.detail: Fill the magic gauge on a huge enemy and end that fight with a Torture Attack.

achievements.name: Umbran Climax
achievements.detail: Spend a full magic gauge on Umbran Climax and extend a combo into a demonic barrage.

achievements.name: Gates of Hell
achievements.detail: Trade halos with Rodin at the Gates of Hell for a technique, item, or weapon.

achievements.name: New Weapon
achievements.detail: Equip a weapon other than the guns you start with and clear a verse with it.

achievements.name: Infernal Demon
achievements.detail: Summon an Infernal Demon fully into battle and let it wipe out the remaining foes.

achievements.name: Muspelheim
achievements.detail: Enter a Muspelheim portal and clear one of the combat trials inside.

achievements.name: Pure Platinum
achievements.detail: Finish a story chapter with a Pure Platinum medal on the results screen.

achievements.name: Cutie J
achievements.detail: Clear a verse while playing as Jeanne in a story chapter or in Tag Climax.

achievements.name: Last Verse
achievements.detail: Clear the final chapter and watch the credits through to the end.
